the six way table at 0x00628704 holds 0x0431df93, 0x0431df9a, 0x0431df9f, 0x0431dfa6, 0x044d798c and 0x044d7999, and the index is the drawn value gated unsigned against the range six

store the accepted candidate at subject + 0x36d4 and return it

runtime_gates: the receiver class is unresolved; the target reads and writes only the cursor word at +0x36d4
0x00a68fb0 is a dependency-only port, so the draw is unverified in this package
the lcg state at 0x01601760 is a program global and its initial value is unverified
the six candidate constants are undecoded
decompilation_defects_corrected: the decompilation types the body as taking one stack argument; the assembly at 0x006286a0 pushes ECX and reads it back with MOV ESI,[ESP+4], so the receiver is both the ECX receiver and the seed, and there is no stack argument at all

the decompilation renders the table as a switch; the assembly indexes the six word table at 0x00628704 with an unsigned compare against the range six, so the corrected model keeps the range gate and the receiver derived seed above it
the decompilation draws once; the assembly loops back to 0x006286f0 while the candidate collides with the stored word, so the corrected model retries
